title: Sar peet ke chillayi ye masoma e muztar
body:
Sar peet ke chillayi ye masooma e muztar, maajaye baradar
Pardes me kis simt tumhe dhoonde ye qwahar, maajaye baradar
1. Mai shouq e ziyarat me watan chod ke aayi, par milne na paayi
Kya daagh dikhaaye ho mujhe haye baradar, maajaye baradar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mai reh gayi hayhaat teri yaad me rote, muh ashkou se dhote
Tum ne naa uthaya mera taboot baradar, maajaye baradar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jis waqt tere tan pa ayaa'n sam ka asar tha, kya haal tha bhaiyya
Batlaao sarhaane tha koi yawar o naser, maajaye baradar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tha koun qaree'n aapke aye sayyad e qushqoo, ya thaamne baazu
Betaab huwe honge jo thaame dil e muztar, maajaye baradar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bhaiyya kaho jab aaqri hichki tumhe aayi, aye haq ke fidaai
Tha kounse hamdard ke zaano pa tera sar, maajaye baradar
